about.companyTitle: Swift Safe Energy (Shenzhen) Technology Co., Ltd.
about.companyDesc:
Swift Safe Energy (Shenzhen) Technology Co., Ltd. is an advanced energy technology enterprise spun off from Beijing Institute of Technology (BIT). Backed by an academician-led team and top-tier global research resources, the company is headed by national overseas high-level talents and brings together an end-to-end engineering team specializing in battery materials, cells, and system operations.

Swift Safe Energy focuses on the R&D and industrialization of high-energy-density, ultra-safe solid-state batteries with supercharging capabilities. By leveraging silicon/full-silicon anodes, high-safety solid electrolytes, and advanced battery structures, the company has established a full-stack proprietary technology framework spanning "Materials–Cells–Systems." Through its disruptive solution integrating rapid heating and solid-state technology, Swift Safe Energy successfully resolves the long-standing industry trilemma of balancing high energy density, ultra-fast charging, and ultimate safety—delivering efficient, safe, and sustainable next-generation power solutions for cutting-edge sectors such as drones/UAVs, eVTOLs, and heavy-duty industrial equipment.
